Tiffany & Co. (known colloquially as Tiffany or Tiffany's) is an American luxury jewelry and specialty retailer, headquartered in New York City . It sells jewelry, sterling silver, china, crystal, stationery, fragrances, water bottles, watches and personal accessories, as well as some leather goods.
Tiffany is renowned for its luxury goods and is particularly known for its diamond and sterling silver jewelry. It markets itself as an arbiter of taste and style. Many of these goods are sold at Tiffany stores, as well as through direct-mail and corporate merchandising.
In 1919, the company made a revision to the Medal of Honor on behalf of the United States Department of the Navy. This Tiffany Cross version was rare because it was awarded only for combat, using the previous design for non-combat awards. In 1942, the Navy established the Tiffany version for non-combat heroism as well but, in August 1942, the Navy subsequently eliminated the Tiffany Cross and the two-medal system.
In 1956, legendary designer Jean Schlumberger joined Tiffany, and Andy Warhol collaborated with the company to create Tiffany holiday cards (circa 1956–1962).[14][21] In 1968, Lady Bird Johnson, First Lady of the U.S. at the time, commissioned Tiffany to design a White House china-service that featured 90 flowers.[22][23]
In November 1978, Tiffany & Co. was sold to Avon Products Inc. for about US$104 million in stock. However, in a 1984 Newsweek article, the Fifth Avenue Tiffany store was likened to the Macy's department store during a white sale, due to the high number of inexpensive items on sale; furthermore, customers complained about declining quality and service. In August 1984, Avon sold Tiffany to an investor group led by William R. Chaney for US$135.5 million in cash. Tiffany went public again in 1987 and raised about US$103.5 million from the sale of 4.5 million shares of common stock.
Due to the 1990–1991 recession in the United States, Tiffany commenced an emphasis upon mass merchandising. A new campaign was launched that stressed how Tiffany could be affordable for all; for example, the company advertised that the price of diamond engagement rings started at US$850. “How to Buy a Diamond” brochures were sent to 40,000 people, who called a toll-free number specifically set up to target the broader population. However, to maintain its image as a luxury goods company, high-style images remained on display in Tiffany stores.

High-poly seesaw for small children from about 3 - 6 years of age, made from Robinia wood. Modelled according to the European standard for (public) playground equipment EN 1176. A swimming pool, swimming bath, wading pool, paddling pool, or simply pool is a structure designed to hold water to enable swimming or other leisure activities. In-ground pools are most commonly constructed from materials such as concrete, natural stone, metal, plastic, or fiberglass, and can be of a custom size and shape or built to a standardized size, the largest of which is the Olympic-size swimming pool.
Many health clubs, fitness centers, and private clubs have pools used mostly for exercise or recreation. Many towns and cities provide public pools. Many hotels have pools available for their guests to use at their own leisure. Educational facilities such as high schools and universities sometimes have pools for physical education classes, recreational activities, leisure, and competitive athletics such as swimming teams. Hot tubs and spas are pools filled with hot water, used for relaxation or hydrotherapy. They are common in hotels and health clubs, and can also be found in many private homes. Special swimming pools are also used for diving, specialized water sports, and physical therapy, as well as for the training of lifeguards and astronauts. Swimming pools may be heated or unheated.

description_text:
Modern turnstile conceptualised to match modern day pandemic scenario. Designed keeping in mind that turnstile and token trasaction kiosks are a point of convergence for a crowd and close proximity should be avoided. Also the idea that a user must not feel clustered or isolated thus avoiding the use of opaque walls and glasses. Thus a turnstile with glass barriers was thought. The scanners can be placed on either sides of entry keeping both left handed and right handed users in mind such that minimum time is spent at such a place where crowd converges. Best suited for place of public gathering like metro stations, bus stations, airports, offices,etc
Glass barriers are keyed with a driver and driven set key constraints. UVs are mapped and equal texel density is maintained.
Do provide with feedback and ideas if you feel there is a problem worth ideating for modern day solutions

This model is a high-end, photorealistic 3D model, that will help you to add realism to your project. The model is highly accurate and based on the manufacturer's original dimensions and technical data.
The model was initially created and fully textured in Blender 2.91, then rendered using Cycles.

All textures and materials are tailored and applied for high-quality render results. Some or all of the materials and textures may be made with Blender's shader nodes. You will get the best results in Blender.
No extra plugins are required for this model. Lights and cameras are not included in the scene.
If this model has stl extension in the file list, stl files have not been tested by printing. If you have any questions while printing, feel free to contact me.

description_text:
A LED display is a flat panel display that uses an array of light-emitting diodes as pixels for a video display. Their brightness allows them to be used outdoors where they are visible in the sun for store signs and billboards. In recent years, they have also become commonly used in destination signs on public transport vehicles, as well as variable-message signs on highways. LED displays are capable of providing general illumination in addition to visual display, as when used for stage lighting or other decorative (as opposed to informational) purposes.
BioTech Industries is a fictional brand name that I use on all sci-fi models**
Hand-painted using Substance Painter. PBR - AR/ VR - Low-Poly
Google, YouTube, Unity and Unreal Engine Friendly
Game-ready
Textures; 2048 x 2048, OpenGL, Dilation + Single Background Colour, 16 Pixel Padding
Maps Include; Base, Normal, Height, Rough, and Metal.
Screen is a separate object part and texture to enable easy exchange/ animation
Please note; This may, or may not 3D Print. Not tested.

description_text:
+++++++++++++++BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

  - If you cannot find the format that you need, contact me before purchasing or reviewing the product. I will assist you, including the refunds.

  - For formats where the model is not subdivision yet, don't worry, contact me and I'll help you with that. ( I will export and send to you high poly/ smooth version ).

  - Because of the different time zones, my response time is usually 12 hours. Please be patient. I will respond as quickly as possible.

+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )

  - Models was textured will be seen in the preview image and the infobox next to it. Models have no texture just contain standard materials.For models have texture:

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.

  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
Golden Snitch from Harry Potter made in Catia V5 and rendered in Keyshot 9 Pro.
Quidditch /ˈkwɪdɪtʃ/ is a fictional sport invented by author J.K. Rowling for her fantasy book series Harry Potter. It first appeared in the novel Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (1997). It is a dangerous but popular sport played by witches and wizards riding flying broomsticks.
Matches are played on a large oval pitch with three ring-shaped goals of different heights on each side, between two opposing teams of seven players each: three Chasers, two Beaters, the Keeper, and the Seeker. The Chasers and the Keeper respectively score with and defend the goals against the Quaffle; the two Beaters bat the Bludgers away from their teammates and towards their opponents; and the Seeker locates and catches the Golden Snitch, whose capture simultaneously wins the Seeker's team 150 points and ends the game. The team with the most points at the end wins.

description_text:
This soccer field model is built to match FIFA standard dimensions for pitch and goal size. The mesh is optimized for a lower polygon count while maintaining the silhouette's shape integrity. It consists entirely of triangles and quads (no n-gons), ensuring clean geometry for all applications.
High-Quality PBR Textures The model features 4K PBR textures that deliver realistic results across various lighting conditions. The texture set includes:

  -   • Albedo

  -   • Metalness

  -   • Roughness

  -   • Opacity

  -   • Ambient Occlusion (AO)

  -   • Normal (GL)These textures provide relatively high texel density even when viewed up close. For example, the pitch grass texture has a texel density of 12 px/cm. If needed, textures can be downscaled to 2048×2048 while still maintaining acceptable texel density. All AO textures are pre-configured in Blender and ready to connect to material shaders.

*Multiple Formats *& Render Compatibility The model is available in multiple formats: Blend, FBX, GLB, and USDZ. It has been tested and works with both Eevee and Cycles render engines, as well as most other 3D viewers and software. Note that some 3D applications may require manual texture setup upon import.
Blender File Organization The provided Blender file is well-organized with named collections and objects. It includes two goal versions:

  -   • Textured net (using an opacity texture) – default version

  -   • 3D mesh net (fully modeled geometry)

Customizable Billboard Signs The billboard signs feature generic names and logos. Their texture and UV layout are designed for easy customization using Blender or image editors like GIMP, Krita, or Affinity Photo. A dedicated UV map for the signs is included for seamless texture replacement. A PDF document with instructions and information on the Blender file, UVs, and Collections is included (in the texture folder). Technical details

  -   • Number of objects: 23, goals (2 versions) corner flags, field, substitute benches, signs.

  -   • Total vertices count: 33,565

Preview Renders & Scene Setup The preview renders use HDRI background textures from Polyhaven.com (not included in the Blender file). However, the Blender file includes a dynamic sky setup with a ready-to-use scene containing a camera and pre-configured settings for both Eevee and Cycles.
Texture Quality Options Textures are provided in both JPG (default, for efficiency and smaller file size) and PNG (higher quality) formats.
 The model has been checked and verified for:

  -   • Face direction (normals)

  -   • Applied modifiers

  -   • Scale and rotation (applied)

  -   • Origin point placement

  -   • Loose geometry (removed)

  -   • Internal faces (removed)

  -   • Face sides (consistent)

description_text:
Level Tool
Ah, the mystical and marvellous construction-level tool! Picture this: it's like a trusty sidekick for construction workers, the Batman to their Robin, the yin to their yang. This magical contraption is a superhero of sorts, swooping in to save the day and ensure that everything is perfectly straight and level.
Imagine a miniature Gandalf, armed with a staff and wearing a tiny hard hat, standing tall and proud, shouting, You shall not pass, crookedness! This tiny wizard is the construction-level tool, ready to vanquish any lopsidedness or wonky angles that dare to challenge the integrity of a building project.
With its sleek body, it boasts a long and slender profile that makes fashion models jealous. It's a slender, sleek stick of justice, laser-focused on achieving perfection. With a bubble-like eye, peering through a transparent window, it sees all and knows all, ensuring that not a single degree of tilt goes unnoticed.
The construction level tool is like a referee at a dance-off, making sure everyone stays in line and dances on the straight and narrow. It refuses to tolerate even the slightest misalignment, glaring at any nail, brick, or tile that dares to deviate from its ordained path. It's a strict disciplinarian, doling out levelness with the sternness of a headmaster, keeping the chaos of slanted surfaces at bay.
But don't let its seriousness fool you! This tool knows how to have fun. It's like a prankster with a mischievous grin, toying with your perception of gravity. Just when you think you've got everything level, it throws you a curveball, a devious giggle escaping from its bubble eye as it reveals the hidden truth of your wonky construction.
In the hands of a skilled worker, the construction level tool is a conductor, orchestrating a symphony of straight lines and right angles. It's like a maestro, directing an architectural masterpiece with a flick of its bubble-filled wand. With a flick here and a tilt there, it brings harmony and precision to the chaotic dance of construction.
So, next time you see a construction level tool in action, give it the respect it deserves. It's not just a tool; it's a comedy magician, a guardian of symmetry, and a straightness superhero all rolled into one.

description_text:
Burj Khalifa - designed and created in Revit and Revit Family 2019
Formats: .rvt .fbx
This model of Burf Khalifa as you can see in images is based on 4 parametric Revit Families. (Sky wire at the top, Railings, Floors and Bottom Floors )
Sky wire, Railings and Bottom floor are a little more easier modelled, but Floor Revit Family is most complex one and with just this one family you can created every floor from bottom to the top.
For better performance i didnt created nested main Revit Family from these 4 Families, but put them straight into the model, because it was crashing, But if you change detail level from fine to medium, it will hide some elements, so model will be very fast and clear.
Materials are created from default library from Revit.
Every Revit Family here has similar parameters, so in the main model you can find them merged in Global Parameters in manage tab such as:Materials for slabs, glass and metal elementsHeight for slabsWidth and Depth for all Facade elementsWidth for Facade ringsHeight for all railings
All complex models such as vegetation, people, cars and some advanced furniture (which can't be created in Revit) are imported from Revit plugin Enscape and only by this program you can render them properly. In other 3d programs(3dsmax, Blender,...) they will show up with low poly faces and can't be used like in Revit and Enscape.
  - All my models are made from scratch in Revit or Revit Family with maximum quality and precision. In the end, you should be able to use it for many similar different projects. If this project contains some parametric Revit Families, you should see them in preview images. If you may know, Revit Family is a sub-program for Revit. You can create models in more complex and different shapes as usual in Revit, and if you put the right parameters for it, you can update this kind of family in more different shapes and sizes, if you have parameters set right. In my all Revit Families on this website, i'm always trying to create and add parameters for main dimensions such as width, height, depth and more and always changeable materials, if you want to put different textures.
For rendered pictures was used program Enscape. I hope u like it :)

description_text:
Authentic Jurassic Park Main Gate 3D Model
Bring a piece of cinematic history into your projects with this highly detailed and accurate recreation of the iconic Jurassic Park main gates from the 1993 film.
This model was created with game integration in mind, making it a great asset for game engines or cinematic projects. The included PBR texture maps are provided in both 4K and 2K resolutions, offering the flexibility to choose between high fidelity for renders or performance for real-time applications.
As a fan of the franchise and a fellow 3D artist, I used this model in my personal project, Jurassic Explorer (version 0.4), which was built in Unreal Engine. You can find a link to the project in my bio, which showcases the model's seamless integration and visual quality in a real-time environment.
Whether you're a filmmaker, a game developer, or a Jurassic Park enthusiast, this model is an excellent addition to your asset library.
Textures included:

  - Albedo / Base Colour

  - Metallic

  - Roughness

  - Normal Map

  - Ambient Occlusion

Feel free to ask for any technical assistance.
Please note: The .FBX and .blend files have been tested and work correctly.

Every mesh in the pack is closed and optimized for real-time rendering. Each model contains collision mesh and it is available in 3 file formats: blend, fbx and obj. Models are scaled according to metric system.
Depending on dedicated usage, each model is provided with 3 sets of textures containing following maps:

  - PBR Metallic/Roughness workflow: Base Color, Roughness, Normal (DirectX), Ambient Occlusion, Metallic; totally 75 16 bit png files, 

  - Unreal Engine 4: Base Color, Normal (DirectX), combined Ambient Occlusion (red channel), Roughness (green channel) and Metallic (blue channel); totally 60 8 bit png files, 

  - Unity: Albedo, Normal (OpenGL), Ambient Occlusion, combined Metallic (RGB) and Smoothness (alpha channel); totally 60 png files.

In order to use our models in preferred game engine please follow official guidelines of its provider.
HDR backgrounds not included.
All meshes in MOUNTAIN ROCK PACK were created using photogrammetry and were optimized for real-time rendering. Models are provided with custom 4K PBR textures allowing for easy building of consistent and detailed environments, which can be used in games, architectural visualisations, animations and still images.

description_text:
An imaginary location in Vecna’s mind representing his ‘curse’ power.
This scene is a low poly reprentaiton of a deconstructed version of the Creel’s House at the center of Vecna’s Mindscape. 
The whole model includes:

  - Main organic black tree

  - Damaged brick wall

  - Creel's door

  - Hardened black sludge ground

  - Old broken staricase

  - Organic black spikes (2 different models)

  - Floating rocks

  - Floating wood rubble

  - Old broken wooden wall (2 different models)

  - Fog cube

  - Cloudy environment created with Dynamic sky

The entire project was developed in Blender. All materials and resources are included. Textures and colors of each object shows a realistic representation of the location. If you want a more red ambientation like the one in the show, you can use #E0673C.
Check out this Instagram effect where a 360 render of this scene was applied: https://www.instagram.com/ar/368264468822124/
Hope you enjoy it!

description_text: The Space Shuttle was a groundbreaking spacecraft and a symbol of human space exploration. Developed by NASA, the Space Shuttle was a reusable vehicle designed to transport astronauts, satellites, and other payloads into space. It consisted of three main components: the orbiter, which carried the crew and payload, the solid rocket boosters for initial propulsion, and the external fuel tank for liquid fuel storage. The Space Shuttle played a pivotal role in numerous historic missions, including the deployment of satellites, construction and maintenance of the International Space Station, and the famous Hubble Space Telescope repair. Its unique ability to launch like a rocket and return to Earth as a glider allowed for cost-effective space operations. The Space Shuttle program spanned over three decades, inspiring generations with its technological advancements and pushing the boundaries of human exploration. While the program has come to an end, the legacy of the Space Shuttle continues to influence future space endeavors, leaving an indelible mark on the history of space exploration.

description_text:
This is a scene to showcase multiple assets I have created. They are fully textured, optimized and game ready. This product is not an environment, it's an assets packs. The environment is just to showcase the assets. Although it is included if you want to mess with it, go ahead.
What you will find in this pack:
-27 Assets in total (models and high-res PBR textures)
-17 of them are completely unique, others are a variation
-The assets are in indiviudal folders, but I have also provided them in one single environment file (FBX, OBJ and in a Blender file)
-I have included the HDRI from the trailer.
-Graffiti and footprint decal textures 
-Authored textures for the broken mirror material.
Friendly disclaimer:
-The texture files are zipped and cannot be linked to the blender file. So the BLENDER SCENE DOES NOT have textures. You're gonna have to manually insert them. Or you can try importing the FBX file which DOES have textures.
-The provided scene is not lit, I have only provided the same HDRI you see in the trailer.
-The pipes, walls and floor assets are not modular, they fit this specific scene only.
-Pills and pill containers were added for a dramatic effect in the video trailer and are NOT included.
This bathroom is a reconstruction based on the one found in Joker (2019). It is old, creepy and abandoned. The lighting is green and orange as seen in the movie.
